data.title: bn-n2lj: fault worker atomic ready-marker publish
data.description: Fix create-vs-write race: parent reads the fault worker ready marker after creation but before content lands (empty -> panic). Worker now writes+fsyncs a temp file then renames into place (atomic). Child-side fault.rs; no source pin; build-children recomputes proof. Tooling self-tests pass.

data.reason: APPROVED. Standard atomic-publish: create_new temp + write_all + sync_all + std::fs::rename (same dir, same fs) so the marker appears with complete contents in one atomic step; the parent's is_file()+read can no longer observe an empty marker. Root cause is a genuine create-before-write TOCTOU (v24 passed by luck, v25 failed 2/2). fault.rs has no source-hash pin; build-children recomputes the fault compile-out authority. Tooling self-tests green. open_findings=0
